Subject: Thank You from the Apple Developer Connection

Dear Tony Meyer,

Thank you for joining the Apple Developer Connection. We're pleased that  
you have chosen to become part of the dynamic and diverse community  
creating innovative products and solutions using Apple technologies.

 Your ADC Member username is: tonyandolyvia@mac.com. This is also your  
Apple ID and it may be used, along with your password, to log in to the ADC  
Member Site and to access many other Apple services.

http://connect.apple.com

The Apple Developer Connection is here to support your success. Please  
visit our website to learn more about the benefits of ADC membership. If  
you have specific questions or if you would like to provide feedback on how  
we can better serve your needs, please contact us.

http://developer.apple.com/membership
http://developer.apple.com/contact

We look forward to helping you make the most of the Apple platform.

-- Your Apple Developer Connection Team
